title: Glance
tagline: AI-powered polling platform that transforms social media insights into interactive polls. Input keywords, get curated content, and generate instant Yes/No or multiple-choice polls to gauge public sentiment on trending topics.
description: The system features an automated content discovery engine that monitors Farcaster, scanning for user-specified keywords. At its core, a language model analyzes the platform to identify trending discussions, organizing them based on key metrics, including topic relevance, audience reach, and user engagement levels. The same model then crafts contextually appropriate poll questions and their corresponding answer options, streamlining the process of gathering community feedback on trending conversations.
how_its_made: This project will leverage AgentKit to handle all AI-related functionality, providing a robust framework for AI interactions and management. For user authentication and access control, we'll implement Privy, which will serve as the login system, handling user sessions and identity verification.
